# Fixture policy

Tests use small synthetic fixtures generated by the owning integration suite,
plus the committed audio timing fixtures documented in
[crates/media/tests/fixtures](../../crates/media/tests/fixtures/README.md).
Benchmark generators and their recorded manifests live under `infra/bench` and
ignored `artifacts/bench` respectively. Ordinary tests download no external corpus;
the opt-in corpus workflow is described in [testing](../README.md).

Prefer small reproducible synthetic assets: oriented/color-tagged still images,
VFR and B-frame video, padded/multiplanar formats, channel-identifiable audio,
nonzero A/V offsets, truncated streams, and midstream format changes.

For each fixture, record the generator command/tool version, expected
timings and format, content hash, origin, and redistribution license. Keep large
corpora outside Git and fetch them only through an explicit, verified workflow.
